review.summary: Static review only: the proposed checker-agnostic run_controls suite is self-contained (stdlib only), probes the o24 axes named in the obligation packet (causal indices, extra/duplicate pairs, staged/identity strip/forge, q_invocation, authority bit), and repairs the prior harness interop by treating differing unproved observations as detected. It is not lead-ready: it lacks an a-priori reservation plan and a per-control expected-outcome matrix against implement vs control-build, so undetected results on known checker gaps can be misread as suite success while forged retained evidence remains acceptable to those checkers.
